prompt: Animate the three bars coming in one after another with a short, snappy stagger, then hold on all three.

args.svg: <svg viewBox="0 0 200 100"><rect id="bar1" x="20" y="20" width="20" height="60"/><rect id="bar2" x="60" y="20" width="20" height="60"/><rect id="bar3" x="100" y="20" width="20" height="60"/></svg>

checks.why: each bar enters, at a different time, within about half a second of each other

expect.$expr: (() => { const starts = {}; for (const s of v.shots) for (const c of s.commands) if (c.type === 'enter') c.targets.forEach((t, i) => { starts[t] = c.start + (c.delay || 0) + i * (c.stagger || 0); }); const xs = ['bar1', 'bar2', 'bar3'].map((b) => starts[b]); return xs.every((x) => x !== undefined) && new Set(xs).size === 3 && Math.max(...xs) - Math.min(...xs) <= 600; })()

checks.why: it ends holding on the bars

shots.$expr: (() => { const s = v[v.length - 1]; return s.end - Math.max(...s.commands.map((c) => c.end)) >= 300; })()

checks.why: no errors or warnings in the check
